about: Agility obstacles, by course. Each obstacle: key, loc (type id), option (the start of the loc's option text), level, xpTenths, at ([x, z, level], only when several locs of one type are different obstacles), routes, and for one that can fail success ([low, high] out of 256, guessed: the Wiki gives no fail rates) and damage ([min, max]).
A route: from ([x, z, level], where the player starts; the nearest route is taken), moves, and fail (the moves of a failure, for an obstacle that can fail).

Moves, in order: anim (anim, ticks: plays it and waits), teleport (to: straight there, another level too), walk (path of [x, z] turning points, anim: one tile a tick through anything, with anim as the whole stance), slide (to, anim, startCycles, endCycles, ticks: the client's exact move; client cycles are 20 ms, 30 a tick).
The courses come with Agility steps 2 to 7.
